title: Boundary-Only Optimization with Frozen Cavity
scientific_hypothesis: The dual-band performance bottleneck in the 10-layer stack resides primarily in the boundary reflection coefficients at the air-coating and coating-substrate interfaces, while the intermediate layers (2-7) have already converged to a near-optimal optical cavity configuration.
design_principle: Freeze intermediate layer thicknesses to preserve established cavity resonance, apply high-resolution local optimization only to boundary layers (0, 1, 8, 9) to refine impedance matching and edge reflection control without disrupting the core interference structure.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | HfO2 | SiO2 | Fused Silica (10 finite layers total, alternating HfO2/SiO2 starting with HfO2)
design_variables: thicknesses of layers 2-7 (frozen to baseline values)
manufacturing_considerations: boundary layer optimization may improve tolerance sensitivity
theory_basis: Transfer matrix method for plane-wave propagation through layered media
Boundary reflection coefficients dominate edge effects in finite periodic stacks
expected_advantages: Focused optimization reduces search space dimensionality
Preserves proven cavity configuration while refining edge matching
May improve best_target_score without increasing layer count
known_risks: Freezing layers may prevent discovery of better global configurations
Boundary-only optimization may have limited impact if cavity itself is suboptimal
execution_request_english: Execute TMM optimization for a 10-layer planar dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2, HfO2, SiO2 (10 finite layers). Initialize layers 2-7 (indices 2,3,4,5,6,7) with frozen thicknesses: [303.15683496802154, 190.12149108544455, 271.5951377488474, 356.06080490914735, 302.68512880416245, 274.1270493753939] nm. Initialize layers 0, 1, 8, 9 at baseline values [342.5104321845845, 188.48902492944148, 247.59229465748604, 114.12305148362653] nm but allow optimization. Use gradient-based local optimizer with high resolution (tolerance 1e-6) on the 4 optimizable boundary layers only. Evaluate transmittance in 1000-1700 nm band and reflectance in 300-450 nm band at normal incidence, unpolarized. Objective: maximize weighted sum of mean transmittance (1000-1700 nm) and mean reflectance (300-450 nm). Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 300-450 nm, 1000-1700 nm. soft objectives: high transmission in 1000-1700 nm; high reflection in 300-450 nm. behaviors to suppress or avoid: reflection in 1000-1700 nm; transmission in 300-450 nm. manufacturing constraints: total layer count <= 30.
revision_reason: Follows feedback directive to freeze intermediate layers (2-7) and optimize boundary layers only, preserving the established optical cavity while refining edge reflection coefficients. Execution request made fully standalone.
